title: 3D M:N Free Sewing (VER4.2.0)
content: ### Objective In the 3D window, freely establish Sewing Lines on Pattern outlines and Internal Shapes/Lines to sew multiple Patterns (M) to multiple Patterns (N) at once. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ M:N Free Sewing 2D or 3D Toolbar ▶ M:N Free Sewing ※ Note: Hold down the Free Sewing tool for a while to access the M:N Free Sewing Tool. ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ M:N Free Sewing 2D or 3D Toolbar ▶ M:N Free Sewing → All sew-able segments are bolded. → All Sewing Lines appear in both 2D and 3D windows. 2. Establish Free Sewing Lines on multiple Patterns, which are considered as M Patterns. 3. Hit the Enter key on the keyboard to complete. → The Sewing Lines appear in neon color. 4. While being mindful of Directional Notches, establish Sewing Lines on Patterns which are sewn to M Patterns. Hit the Enter key on the keyboard to complete M:N Sewing Lines. → All Sewing Lines no longer appear in neon color. ※ Note: * While establishing the Sewing Lines, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to cancel the last action or hit the Esc key on the keyboard to cancel all actions. * While establishing M:N sewing lines, if you click on an inappropriate segment, the segment appears in red and the Sewing Line cannot be applied. ※ Note: 3D Sewing Video
content_description: The M:N Free Sewing tool allows users to easily create and manage Sewing Lines on multiple patterns in both 2D and 3D views, streamlining the sewing process for complex designs.

title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Face Setting
content: ### Objective Select the face of Topstitch. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Topstitch ▶ Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Face ### Explanation ![topstitchFront.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438783711769) | Topstitch is only set for the front of the Fabric. ---|--- ![topstitchBack.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438783876377) | Topstitch is only set for the back of the Fabric. ![topstitchBoth.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438812482457) | Topstitch is set for the both sides of the Fabric. ※Note: Topstitch placed on the back of the Fabric do not appear in the 2D window (ver4.2.0).

title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Offset
content: ### Objective Adjust the interval between Topstitches on Internal Lines or Pattern outlines. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Topstitch ▶ Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Offset ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Topstitch ▶ Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Offset 2. Adjust the interval. → The value is now being adjusted and applied.

title: Merge Points on Internal Lines
content: ### Objective Join or merge two open points on Internal Lines. ※ Note: When a point on the Internal Line is open, it is hollow, whereas when a point on the Internal Line is closed, it is filled. ### Location Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern ### Operation #### Join Overlapping Points 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2. Select overlapping points and right click to access the pop-up menu. Then, select Join Overlapping Points. → Two overlapping points are joined and closed. #### Merge to Point 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern 2. Select two points on Internal Lines to be merged. 3. Right click on the point which the other point should be merged to. When the pop-up menu appears, select Merge to Point. → The point is merged to the right-clicked point. #### Merge to Average 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern 2. Select two points on the Internal Lines to be merged. Then, right click on either point to access the pop-up menu and select Merge to Average. → The selected points are merged to their average point. #### Intersect & Merge 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern 2. Select two points to be merged. 3. Right click on the points to access the pop-up menu and select Intersect & Merge. → The selected points are shortened or extended maintaining their current slope and are merged where they intersect.
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions for joining or merging open points on Internal Lines in a 2D pattern editing tool.

title: Zoom In/Out, Rotation
content: ### Objective In Marvelous Designer, the mouse wheel and the right button can be used to zoom in, zoom out, and rotate the screen. The Maya and 3Ds Max view control methods are also supported alongside the default view control method and interface can be modified as needed and use differently. ### Operation #### Move Hold down the mouse wheel and drag to move the screen. If you are using Mac's Magic Mouse, please hold down the Alt key on the keyboard and click-and-drag the left mouse key. #### Zoom In/Out Scroll down (zoom in) and up (zoom out) the mouse wheel to zoom in and zoom out the screen. Or, hold down Alt Key on the keyboard and the left button of the mouse simultaneously and drag up (zoom out) or down (zoom in). ※ Note: Zoom in or zoom out using the + (zoom in) and - (zoom out) keys on the keyboard (ver2.4.0.) #### Rotate Hold down the right button of the mouse and drag to rotate the 3D window.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide to navigating the 3D interface in Marvelous Designer using mouse controls and customizable view options.

title: TOPSTITCH PROPERTIES: Flip Topstitch
content: ### Objective Use the Flip function to set a Topstitch on an Internal Shape/Line in a different direction (inside and outside). When setting the Topstitch on the Pattern's cutting line, the Topstitches always appear on the inside of a Garment and the Flip function gets deactivated. ### Location Property Editor ▶ Placement ▶Flip ### Operation 1. Select a Topstitch with Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window for changing its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor ▶ Placement ▶Flip → The Topstitch direction will now be changed.
content_description: This web page provides a concise guide on using the Flip function in the Property Editor to adjust the direction of Topstitches on internal shapes or lines in garment patterns.

title: [Property] Scale Avatars
content: ### Objective Scale an OBJ imported as an Avatar. ### Location Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ Select/Move 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ### Operation 1. Import an .OBJ as an Avatar. (ver. 10) Import a .FBX as an Avatar. (ver. 2024.0) 2. Select the tool/ menu indicated in Location. 3. Select the Avatar and click the Scale button to resize the Avatar. → The scale Gizmo appears. 4. Click and drag the Gizmo's X-axis (red), Y-axis (yellow-green), Z-axis (blue) or the rectangle. → The Avatar size is adjusted according to the selected direction. 5. Click the Scale button to complete scaling. → The Gizmo is changed to a standard one that is used to move or rotate the Avatar. ※ Note: Scale with specific values in the Property Window after selecting the Avatar.
content_description: Learn how to import and scale an OBJ or FBX file as an Avatar in our 3D garment design tool.

title: Add Bounding Voulme
content: ### Objective Add a Bounding Volume to add arrangement points. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ▶ Arrangement ▶ Bounding Volume ▶ Add ### Operation 1\. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ▶ Arrangement ▶ Bounding Volume ▶ Add → A new Bounding Volume called "Pan" is now being created at the bottom of the Bounding Volume list, and its properties appear in the Property Editor. 2\. Set details for Bounding Volume. Board | Check the list of currently added layouts and edit the properties of the layout by selecting the desired item. ---|--- Name | Changes the name of the Bounding Volume. Arrangement BV | Joint Name 0 | Set the position of the joint(X-ray joint point) where the Bounding Volume starts. Joint Name 1 | Set the position of the joint(X-ray joint point) where the Bounding Volume ends. Shape (ver MD10) | Depending on the shape of the Avatar, the Bounding Volume is set to the Cylinder and Cuboid. Height | Sets the height of the Bounding Volume. Length X | Adjusts the circumference of the left and right radii of the Bounding Volume. Length Y | Adjusts the circumference of the top and bottom radii of the Bounding Volume. Round Corner (ver MD10) | ※ It is active only when the Bounding Volume type is set to Cuboid. Adjust the radius of each corner. Hands/Feet | If this option is activated, the length of the Bounding Volume is adjusted to the avatar's hands and feet. The moment you click that option, the entire Bounding Volume is refreshed. ※ Note: If the order below/above the joint points is reversed, the left and right sides are flipped when arranging the Pattern.
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions for adding and configuring a Bounding Volume in the Avatar Editor to enhance arrangement points for avatars.

title: How to Fix the Error using Intel Graphics Card
content: ### Objective Learn how to resolve launching error using Intel HD Graphics. ### Operation Since this crashing is due to a Graphic driver which is automatically updated by Microsoft Windows, please re-install the Intel graphics driver after deactivating "Windows Automatic Updates". ### Case 1 1\. Please input "gpedit.msc" on Search tool and execute it. 2\. Local Group Policy Editor ▶ Computer Configuration ▶ Administrative Templates ▶ Windows Components ▶ Windows Updates ▶ activate "Do not include drivers with Windows Update" ![0.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438341413785)※ Note: The option may not appear in the Window versions below. In this case, External Graphics card should be used. (Please refer to [Computer Specification](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358219834649)) Windows 7 Home Edition / Windows 10 Home Edition 3\. Device Manager ▶ Display Adapters ▶ Intel(R) HD Graphic ▶ Uninstall the device and driver software ▶ Reboot Windows ![1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438341588761) 4\. Enter [Intel Support Page](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/intel-driver-support-assistant.html) and download and install the program of Intel® Driver & Support Assistant. 5\. Start scanning the driver. 6\. Download and Reinstall the driver of Intel(R) HD Graphics. 7\. Verify the "23.20.16.4901" version is installed correctly.![2.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438420736281) 8\. Please reboot Windows. 9\. If the Error is not resolved with Case 1, please proceed Case 2 below. ### Case 2 If the Error is not resolved with Case 1, please proceed Case 2. 1\. Please enter [Intel® Graphics Driver for Windows*](https://downloadcenter.intel.com/download/30196/Intel-Graphics-Driver-for-Windows-15-40-) and Download & Install the driver. 2\. Approve overwrite to the previous version during Installation. ![3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438420990617)
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions for resolving launching errors caused by Intel HD Graphics driver issues on Windows systems.

title: I got an email titled "Update Required: Your account is on hold." What does it mean?
content: # **New License Status Policy Announcement: License Suspension After Payment Failure** **Q. I got an email titled "Update Required: Your account is on hold." What does it mean?** **A:** You received this email because your payment attempt during the checkout process failed. This can happen due to reasons such as: * Insufficient funds * Expired credit card * Declined transaction As a result, your license was not activated, and the system has automatically suspended your license status until a successful payment is completed. ⏳ A 7-day grace period is provided, during which the system will attempt two automatic retries to process the payment. * The first retry will occur 3 days later, and the second retry will take place on the final day of the suspension period. If either payments fails, your subscription will be automatically canceled. * * * ## ## **How to Reactivate Your License** 1. Go to “[ _**My Account > License**_](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license)” and update your payment method if you wish to continue your subscription. 2. If at least one of the two retry attempts succeeds, the subscription will be reinstated. 3. If you wish to cancel your subscription, a Cancel button is available in the “[ _**My Account > License**_](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license) _**”**_ section. ## **Additional Notes** Only personal monthly licenses (recurring payment including trial license) are eligible for suspension and reactivation. This policy does not apply to: * Personal 1 Year Licenses * Enterprise Licenses * Student Licenses
content_description: Stay informed about our new license status policy, which outlines the process and steps for reactivating your license following a payment failure.

title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Physical Property Detail Setting
content: Adjust each item of the detailed settings to express Physical Properties not included in Presets. Each property mutually affects one another and a Garment's physical property is expressed by combination of all detailed property values. ※ Note: * The property details are adjustable with the scroll bar or by entering in actual measurement values. * Scroll Bar [0~99]: This is better input method when the constant value is far too enormous. To reduce this inconvenience, the most commonly used Physical Property is split into 99 stages. * Constant Value [0~1000000000] This is better input method when setting far more accurate Physical Properties than the scroll bar method above.
content_description: "Customize and fine-tune your garment's unique physical properties through detailed adjustable settings, ensuring a precise expression of characteristics beyond standard presets."

title: Segment Topstitch
content: ### Objective Create a Segment Topstitch (Patterns or Internal Shapes that are split by points). ### Location Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Topstitch ▶ Segment Topstitch 2D Toolbar ▶ Segment Topstitch ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Topstitch ▶ Segment Topstitch 2D Toolbar ▶ Segment Topstitch 2. title: 2D Environment setting: Fix Grid Display
content: ### Objective This option is to fix the grid spacing regardless of the zoom of the 2D window, which makes it easier to recognize the magnification or reduction of the 2D window. ### Location Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on the 2D window) ▶ 2D Pattern Window Properties ### Operation 1\. title: Automatically Create Fitting Suit at Import
content: ### Objective Automatically generate a Fitting Suit for a custom bipedal avatar at import. * * * ### Location Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ OBJ/FBX ▶ **Auto Create Fitting Suit**. **** ### Operation 1. Select the tool/menu indicated above under "Location". 2. Select either OBJ or FBX file format for import. 3. Navigate to the file location for a custom bipedal avatar (two arms, two legs, no tail) in either A-Pose or T-Pose, and double-click on the file name. → The Import OBJ/FBX pop-up Window appears. 4. Make sure the **Load Type** is set to **Open** and the **Object Type** is set to **Avatar**. 5. Check the option box next to **Auto Create Fitting Suit** 6. Click on **OK**. → The Avatar is imported into the scene and a Fitting Suit is automatically created in the process.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for automatically generating a fitting suit for custom bipedal avatars during the import process.

title: Marvelous Designer Standalone License Transition
content: **Effective Date:** December 2, 2025 This document outlines the discontinuation of the Marvelous Designer Standalone license and establishes the transition procedures for all existing Standalone license holders. As of the Effective Date, the Marvelous Designer Standalone Online license will be retired and will no longer be available for purchase. ## **Continued Support for Existing Licenses** All existing Standalone licenses will continue to be fully supported and will retain all current features until their expiration date. #### ## **Transition Offer for Annual Standalone Licenses** To facilitate a seamless transition, a transition offer is being provided for a grace period to all Annual Standalone license holders. * **Offer Period:** The grace period for this offer is from the Effective Date until **June 30, 2026**. * **Transition Option:** During this period, users can transition to a Network Online license at the same annual renewal price of **$1900 USD per license**. * **Automatic Upgrade:** Upon renewal, the user’s existing Annual Standalone license will be automatically upgraded to a Network Online License for the remainder of its current term, in addition to the new annual term. #### ## **Transition for Monthly Standalone Licenses** * All existing Monthly Standalone license holders will be seamlessly transitioned to the new Subscription License * This license shall provide the same feature to that of the current Monthly Standalone License without the node-lock system. #### ## **Table of Enterprise Licenses as of Dec. 2** **Name** | **Price** | **Description** | **OS** ---|---|---|--- ENTERPRISE MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION | $199/month | Full MD experience with limited Userpool feature Only available via subscription on the website | Windows, Mac ENTERPRISE ANNUAL NETWORK | $2,000/year | Full MD experience with Userpool feature | Windows, Mac ENTERPRISE LINUX | $2,300/year | Full MD experience with Userpool feature | Linux only *The Userpool feature simplifies user account management, allowing you to easily assign purchased licenses to multiple end-user IDs. ([Userpool Manual](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358149827609-User-Pool-Manual))
content_description: This webpage provides essential information on the discontinuation of the Marvelous Designer Standalone license, outlining transition procedures and support options for existing license holders effective December 2, 2025.

title: Troubleshooting with HASP Driver Errors
content: ## **The Latest HASP driver download (updated June 2022)** * [Mac version](https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/Sentinel_Runtime_94691.tar) * [Linux version](https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/aksusbd-8.31.1.tar) * [Windows version ](https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/haspdinst_8_31.exe) ## **Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on Windows** ### **Objective** The Sentinel HASP Diver is automatically installed with the software, but it fails occasionally. Please download and install the Sentinel HASP Driver which is suitable for your operating system. ### **Operation** **Installing Sentinel Driver on Windows** 1\. Download the driver from the link below. [Windows HASP Driver Download](https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.md.web.upload/newmdweb/helpcenter/installer/haspdinst_8_31+\(2\).exe) 2\. Enter "CMD" in 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' to install the driver. 3\. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and put it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path as shown underlined below. Enter "-i" behind the automatically entered path and press 'Enter' on keyboard to install. ![0.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438481245593) 4\. Access to [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html) and check to see if the following screen appears to see if the HASP Driver has been successfully installed. If the following screen appears, then installation is successful. ![1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438509264281) 5\. If the following error occurs, the HASP Driver must be deleted and reinstalled. ![2.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438526236825) ![3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438526436121) #### **Deleting Sentinel Driver on Windows** 1\. Download the driver from the link below. [HASP Driver Download](https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.md.web.upload/newmdweb/helpcenter/installer/haspdinst_8_31+\(2\).exe) 2\. Enter "CMD" in 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' to delete the driver. ![4.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438482016025) 3\. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and put it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path as shown underlined below. Enter "-purge -r" behind the corresponding path and press 'Enter' on keyboard to delete. ![5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438482218649) 4\. After the driver has been successfully deleted, refer to reinstall the driver. ## Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on MAC ### **Objective** The Sentinel HASP Diver is automatically installed with the software, but it fails occasionally. Please download and install the Mac OS Sentinel HASP Driver. ### **Operation** #### Installing Sentinel Driver on Mac * Sentinel Driver for Mac [Download](https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.md.web.upload/newmdweb/helpcenter/installer/Sentinel_Runtime.tar) 1\. Please remove all the dongle keys inserted into the Mac for installation to be done correctly. 2\. Mount "Sentinel_Runtime.dmg" (ver 21.0 Build 77815) ![9.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438527013401) 3\. Double-click the Install Sentinel Runtime Environment icon. 4\. Please allow the 'hasplmd' application to accept incoming network connections (this message may not appear). 5\. Access to [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html) 6.If you are unable to connect to the URL, try again after 10 seconds later. If it still does not work, reboot and connect again. If the solutions above do not work, please go back to the first step and check again. ![6.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438527230489) *If you click Diagnostics, License Manager Version appears with newly installed version; ver 21.0 Build 77815 (Version information of 21.0 Build 77815 appears as this in Diagnostics). ![7.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438482949657) 7\. Insert Dongle key into USB port. 8\. If the Dongle key appears in 'Sentinel Keys', the installation is successfully done. ![8.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438527554841) #### Reinstalling Sentinel on Mac 1\. Please remove all the dongle keys from USB port. 2\. Mount "Sentinel_Runtime.dmg" with version of "ver 21.0 Build 77815". ![9.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438527013401) 3.Double-click Uninstall Sentinel Runtime Environment. ![10.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438483463065) 4\. Click Uninstall. ![11.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438483624985) 5.If the un-installation is done normally, the dialog above appears. Please press OK button and then click Quit. 6.Reboot your Mac. 7.Install Sentinel Driver. Please refer to the following method; *If you don't follow the guideline, you may not be able to find Dongle keys inserted into your PC or other PCs. Also the other PCs may not be able to find your Dongle key. #### #### Sentinel Driver Known Bugs * Sentinel LDK Protection System Error : invalid XML scope (36) Normally occurred when operating in Marvelous Designer modelist network dongle 1.4.14.7701 (Enveloped with Sentinel LDK 6.4 version or before 6.4). * Occurs with the following conditions: → Network Dongle key (not a local Dongle key) → Marvelous Designer Modelist Network with 2.1.44 or later version. (Enveloped with Sentinel LDK 7.1) → The Dongle key is inserted into another PC. → The version of Sentinel Driver is 13.20 in your Mac. → Operates normally after reinstalling with Mac Sentinel Driver ver 16.0. * If multiple Sentinel Drivers are mounted, the software is unable to find virtual files. If a driver is already mounted, please demount(or eject) it and mount new driver. * Sentinel Driver starts to operate in a few seconds. On occasion, it does not start. In that case, please reboot your PC. * All the Dongle keys should be removed when uninstalling Sentinel Driver. ![12.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438483927577)
content_description: This web page provides the latest Sentinel HASP driver downloads and installation instructions for Windows, Mac, and Linux, along with troubleshooting tips for common driver errors.

title: Linear Avatar Tape  (ver. 5.1.4)
content: ### Related articles [Circumference Avatar Tape](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358245043225) [Attach to Avatar Tape](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358293301145) [Delete Avatar Tape](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358298422553) ### Objective Create a linear baseline to improve accuracy in fit and draping on the 3D window. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Avatar Tape ▶ Linear Avatar Tape 3D Toolbar ▶ Linear Avatar Tape ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Avatar Tape ▶ Linear Avatar Tape 3D Toolbar ▶ Linear Avatar Tape 2. Click to make the beginning point of the tape at a desired place. → Blue dot appears and gets fixed. ※ Note: Pressing the Shift key on the keyboard before creating the beginning point provides a guideline on the avatar. 3. Click another place to make the second point. → Another blue dot appears and gets fixed and a connected line between both of the dots appears. 4. Double-click to complete.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for using Linear Avatar Tape to establish a baseline for enhanced fit and draping accuracy in 3D design.

title: Copy/Paste
content: ### Objective Copy and Paste Patterns as needed. ### Location 2D Tool Bar ▶ Transform Pattern Tool or Edit Pattern Tool ### Operation 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. 2. Right Click Pop-Up Menu (On Pattern or Internal Line) ▶ Copy (Ctrl+C) or Paste (Ctrl+V) → Clone of the Pattern follows along the mouse cursor. 3. Clone on the desired position within the 2D window to place the clone. → The Pattern and Internal Line are copied to the clicked point. ※ Note: * When pasting, hold down the Shift key to place a Pattern on the vertical/horizontal/45˚ line. * Patterns can be copied and pasted even between multiple executed programs. * When pasting, Right Click to enter Interval/Number of Shapes/Position(Internal Line) values. * A part of internal shapes can be copied and paste. (ver MD10)
content_description: This web page provides a concise guide on how to efficiently copy and paste patterns using the Transform or Edit Pattern tools in a 2D environment.

title: Change Pose by OBJ Morphing
content: ### Objective Vertex Morphing has a merit of maintaining avatar's final form without any distortion. However on the other hand, garments may fall off during the morphing process, especially when there is a large difference between the first and the last pose as the pose changes by the minimum distances between points in the avatar rather than the units of avatar joints. Therefore if a big difference between the poses, it is recommended to create an OBJ file for interim pose and morph stage-by-stage. If it is inconvenience, change pose by another method, Change Pose by Using Collada. ### Operation 1. After dressing an avatar in CLO, at least two files are required to change poses such as T-pose avatar and another avatar in desired pose. Export both of the files in OBJ format. To find export method in details, check 3D File (OBJ) Import/Export for the reference. 2. Click File ▶ Import ▶ OBJ and select the T-pose OBJ file of the previously exported avatar. Click OK on the option dialogue to load the avatar. 3. Put the garments on top of the loaded avatar. 4. Click File ▶ Import ▶ OBJ Load as Morph Target the previously saved avatar with another pose. Set the 'Morphing Frame Count' in the option dialogue, then click OK. 5. The Simulation button automatically activates and the avatar pose slowly changes according to the set frame count. The garment also starts simulating in accordance with the change. Adjust garments if necessary, after the final pose simulation.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for using Vertex Morphing to change avatar poses in CLO while ensuring garments remain intact and properly fitted throughout the process.
